kind_why: A combat surf map: built to fight on rather than to time (see notes). 'arena' keeps it out of g2gfast's rotation, vote and nominations -- it stays installed, loadable with `map`, and listed on M as combat -- and marks it for game-arena's deathmatch.
author: matrix-hetman
notes: Credit only, and deliberately no zones: a combat surf map with no finish (see maps/zones/README.md). 16 T and 16 CT spawns, 17 placed weapons, and team routes (g1..g4, b1..b4) each with one teleport -- built for two teams to fight across. gb-maps-1 batch of 2026-10-09. Not published.
